# Copilot Instructions

- Canonical engineering rules: `.specify/memory/constitution.md`
- Universal agent contract: `AGENTS.md`
- Specifications and plans: `specs/` and `.specify/`
- Architecture decisions (ADRs): `docs/architecture/decisions/`
- Work tracking contract: every material code change must link to a governing GitHub Issue/spec and corresponding PR evidence.

Before implementation, read the governing issue/spec and repository truth files.
